    What is real. Every frame is drawn by Ink (the app's drawing library) at the picked size in 256 colours. Today = the app's own code; drawn this way its “model off” screen matches the real app run in a pseudo-terminal row for row (only the random tip differs), and “/start typed” is taken from that real run. Real: your model and settings, conversations and times, git, notes, your Mac's memory (16 GB, 8.6 GB free) and what Qwen3.5 9B takes at 32k by the app's count (5.4 GB). Made up: the new folder's name, the load clock (≈ 5 s + 26 s reading), the memory once loaded.
